issues.message: Project metadata has incorrect framework list: includes 'Next.js' (not used) but omits Vite, Firebase, Framer Motion, Three.js, SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn — all present in scan-result.json frameworks array
Project metadata missing languages: Dockerfile and Markdown not listed in graph's languages array but present in scan-result.json languages array

ScanningSkeleton extracted as a class inside DataFlowEffect.tsx (`class:frontend/src/components/animations/DataFlowEffect.tsx:ScanningSkeleton`) but it has its own dedicated file ScanningSkeleton.tsx — likely a parser error confusing an import/export as a class definition

Barrel re-export files cause 7 duplicate class nodes: landing/index.ts re-exports LandingPage, Header, Features, Stats, HowItWorks, Trust, Footer — each appears as a class node in both their original .tsx file AND in index.ts. 1 duplicate in hero/index.ts for BiasNetworkHero
270 of 408 nodes (66%) have completely uninformative summaries matching the pattern 'Function {name}' or 'Class {name}' — these provide no semantic description of what the function/class does
23 nodes have generic summaries like 'Project file', 'Frontend source module', or 'Frontend configuration file' — fails to convey the purpose of these artifacts
12 node summaries use the pattern 'Backend module: {filename}' which merely repeats the filename without adding context
Layer 'backend-config' includes test_sample.csv (a CSV dataset) and unbiased_ai.db (a SQLite database) alongside config and entry-point files — these are data artifacts, not configuration
Layer 'frontend-app' includes playwright-report/index.html, which is a generated Playwright test report artifact, not an application shell component
Layer 'backend-utils' includes uvicorn log files (uvicorn_err.txt, uvicorn_out.txt) alongside utility Python modules — log files are runtime artifacts, not utilities

Tour step 7 ('Workflow Pipeline UI') only references 3 of the 9 workflow steps (Step1, Step4, Step9), skipping critical steps like Step2Config, Step5Explanations, Step6Counterfactual, Step7StressTest, Step8Sandbox which are equally important for understanding the pipeline

warnings: All 138 files from scan inventory have corresponding graph nodes — no missing files detected
No orphan graph nodes — every node filePath matches an entry in the scan inventory
All 458 edges reference existing node IDs — structural edge integrity verified
All 15 layers reference existing nodeIds — layer structural integrity verified
All 9 tour steps reference existing nodeIds — tour structural integrity verified
Class/function sub-element nodes (270 of 408 total nodes) are excluded from layer nodeIds, which is expected since layers index only file-level nodes

"signup" appears 3 times as a node name but these are legitimate distinct elements (backend auth signup function, frontend auth signup function, and frontend Signup page component) — no deduplication needed
FirebaseConfigError and getConfigError appear in both auth.ts and config.ts — these are actually separate classes/functions in different modules, not duplicates
The graph reuses a previously assembled graph from a prior analysis run — this review confirms it is structurally valid with no missing/orphan files

suggestedFixes: Correct project.frameworks to match scan: ["FastAPI", "React", "Vite", "Firebase", "Framer Motion", "Three.js", "SQLAlchemy", "scikit-learn"] — remove Next.js
Remove the spurious ScanningSkeleton class node from DataFlowEffect.tsx — it's a parsing artifact
Deduplicate barrel re-export class nodes: either skip barrel index.ts files during extraction, or filter out re-exported class nodes from index files
Improve summary quality for 270 function/class nodes by extracting docstrings or using semantic analysis to describe their purpose
Improve 23 generic file summaries ('Project file', 'Frontend source module', etc.) with actual descriptions of the file's role
Move test_sample.csv and unbiased_ai.db out of layer:backend-config into a more appropriate layer, or create a separate layer
Move playwright-report/index.html out of layer:frontend-app into layer:test or exclude test artifacts from node extraction
Expand tour step 7 to include all 9 workflow steps, or at minimum add Step2Config and Step5Explanations which are critical to the pipeline understanding
